people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Beer-lahai-roi
people.line: Well where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
translations.bsb: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son. And Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
